conversion_notes: Equations are LaTeX transcriptions of the expressions printed in the PDF; equation numbers are preserved with \tag{...} where present.
The conversion is source-faithful rather than mathematically normalized; apparent source inconsistencies are preserved as printed (see README.md).
Figures are kept as raster crops because their axes, legends and multi-panel layout are more reliable as images than as extracted text.
PDF line-wrap artifacts, repeated page headers/footers, page numbers and the SSRN footer were removed.
